changelog: New Army tab in battle: open it to see every unit in the field with a quick HP / AP / ATK / DEF snapshot, tap a unit to center the camera on it, and flag exactly who you want to keep when the battle is won. Retained units get first claim on your permanent roster slots — you can flag up to your roster cap (which grows as you earn recruitment medals), and it won't let you over-commit. If you don't touch it, your existing roster carries as before.
